title: Explainable AI as a Double-Edged Sword in Dermatology: The Impact on Clinicians versus The Public

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring human over-reliance on AI by comparing diagnostic accuracy and confidence when participants are presented with correct versus incorrect AI predictions, and tracking the proportion of 'deferential' participants across different Explainable AI (XAI) modalities.

Evaluating diagnostic accuracy and performance disparities of both the AI model and human participants when diagnosing clinical images of patients with light skin (Fitzpatrick types 1-4) compared to dark skin (Fitzpatrick types 5-6).

Comparing human diagnostic performance and AI deference rates between a 'Human-First' workflow (making an initial diagnosis before seeing AI input) and an 'AI-First' workflow (seeing AI suggestions upfront) to measure the anchoring effect of AI advice.
